title: Capture feature route and API doc screenshots
description:
Problem: feature route and API/MCP documentation now include ID-tagged screenshot placeholders but no final images.

Desired outcome: capture and embed the screenshots needed for route-map and API/MCP feature pages so the docs are visually complete.

Scope:
- In scope: placeholders `FEAT-ROUTE-01..03` in `features/route-map` and `FEAT-API-01..04` in `features/api-and-mcp`; image capture, redaction, asset naming, markdown insertion.
- Out of scope: auth/admin sensitive views (tracked separately).

Acceptance criteria:
- Every listed placeholder ID has a corresponding image in `Data/Pages/assets`.
- Markdown pages embed each image near its placeholder location and render correctly in `/pages`.
- Captures do not expose secrets, tokens, private usernames, or internal host details.

Validation:
- Open both pages in `/pages` and confirm all images load with no broken links.
- Confirm image filenames map one-to-one with placeholder IDs.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track FEAT-ROUTE and FEAT-API screenshot capture and insertion.
